# New Play-Callers — 15 programmes

> **Source: 2026 VSiN College Football Betting Guide.** GUIDE CONTENT throughout — no outside research and no post-publication updates. Continuity readings come from Steve Makinen's printed Stability Score table (pp. 41–44), reproduced exactly; this library does not recompute or re-weight it.

> **The guide's assessment travels with the change.** This index does not treat a change as good or bad. Where VSiN takes a view, that view is reproduced; where it does not, the row says so.

Play-caller and coordinator are not the same field. This index lists the programmes where the guide states that the person calling plays has changed, or that a head coach is calling them himself — including cases where the Stability Score table still awards points for a returning coordinator.

| Team | Conf | What the guide states |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Ball State Cardinals](ball_state_cardinals.md) | MAC | Mike Uremovich, explicitly, and the guide is direct about the result: as his own play-caller, last year's results were pathetic. |
| [Baylor Bears](baylor_bears.md) | Big 12 | Changed on defense in a way the guide treats as significant: Dave Aranda has stopped calling the defense, which it calls a wise step aside despite his reputation as a defensive mind, with Klanderman taking over. Jake Spavital calls the offense. |
| [Boston College Eagles](boston_college_eagles.md) | ACC | Bill O'Brien on offense, explicitly — the guide notes he is serving as his own coordinator. |
| [Clemson Tigers](clemson_tigers.md) | ACC | Changed on offense, and the guide treats the personal dimension as the point rather than the scheme: Swinney and Riley were oil and water, and Swinney should be relieved to have Morris back. |
| [Maryland Terrapins](maryland_terrapins.md) | Big Ten | Changed on offense. Trickett takes over the coordinator's job with Hamilton moved upstairs. |
| [Navy Midshipmen](navy_midshipmen.md) | American | Changed on defense, and the guide treats the change as the story: sensing urgency, Newberry is returning to his roots as his own defensive play-caller, having demoted P.J. Volker to safeties coach and promoted Eric Lewis to coordinator. |
| [Northwestern Wildcats](northwestern_wildcats.md) | Big Ten | Chip Kelly, as the new coordinator. |
| [Ohio State Buckeyes](ohio_state_buckeyes.md) | Big Ten | Not addressed in guide by name. The guide attributes the expected tactical change to Arthur Smith. |
| [Oklahoma Sooners](oklahoma_sooners.md) | SEC | Not addressed in guide by name, though the guide says better play-calling is needed on the ground alongside the new offensive linemen. |
| [Ole Miss Rebels](ole_miss_rebels.md) | SEC | Changed, and the guide treats it as material: Golding had Weis calling plays in the postseason and now does not. |
| [Oregon Ducks](oregon_ducks.md) | Big Ten | Dan Lanning on defense, explicitly — the guide states he calls it himself and on that basis expects another elite unit. |
| [Purdue Boilermakers](purdue_boilermakers.md) | Big Ten | Kevin Kane on defense, and the guide treats the arrangement as changed: he now has more autonomy calling the defense than he had under Ryan Walters. |
| [South Carolina Gamecocks](south_carolina_gamecocks.md) | SEC | New. The guide states Beamer has nine offensive starters back and a new play-caller, and identifies Briles as the man taking over. |
| [Texas A&M Aggies](texas_aandm_aggies.md) | SEC | New on offense. The guide lists a new offensive play-caller among the obstacles and names Holmon Wiggins, leaving open whether the change aids Marcel Reed's development. |
| [ULM Warhawks](ulm_warhawks.md) | Sun Belt | Changed, and the guide treats the change as encouraging in itself: Vincent is giving up the coordinator role to better oversee the programme, and it argues too many young and first-time head coaches take on too much and cannot properly manage the rest of the job. |
